research_question: When every V53 transition and fallback is fixed, does distinguishing metalinguistic denial of request status from explicit action prohibition remove the three concentrated V53 errors without any regression?
project_effect: Preserve a cognitively meaningful distinction between talking about a quoted command and prohibiting the represented action. Both prevent immediate execution, but they should not collapse into the same internal state.
evidence_boundary: This is a one-change development replay on the consumed V52 corpus after inspecting V53 failures. It can authorize only construction of a new independent V54 holdout. It cannot authorize runtime, shadow integration, physical VRM execution, or a human-likeness claim.

single_causal_change.v53_behavior: The quoted-data rule classifies explicit nonexecution, instruction denial, command denial, and request denial together as negated.
single_causal_change.v54_behavior: Only explicit execution or action prohibition remains negated. A statement that quoted text is not an instruction, command, or request becomes mentioned.
single_causal_change.metalinguistic_nonrequest_pattern: (?:指示|命令|お願い)[^。！？!?]{0,8}(?:ではない|じゃない|ではありません)

target_mention_patterns.expression.neutral: (?:ニュートラル|いつも通り|いつもの|無表情|普通|標準|真顔|元)
target_mention_patterns.gaze.user: (?:会話相手|こちら|こっち|正面|カメラ|目線|私|俺|僕|目)
target_mention_patterns.motion.idle: (?:そのままの姿勢|動かない|動かず|じっと|アイドル|待機)

decision_rule.advance: Every inherited V53 gate and every V54-specific gate must pass before an independent holdout may be constructed.
decision_rule.failure: Any unrelated regression rejects V54. Do not tune a failed V54 under this preregistration.
decision_rule.boundary: A development pass is not fresh evidence and does not authorize integration or execution.
